name: T01

theorem T01 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.modeTr N M = m.trJ * M - (m.Du + m.Dv) * N := by
  intro m N M
  unfold Scope.Model.modeTr Scope.Model.trJ
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.modeTr N M = m.trJ * M - (m.Du + m.Dv) * N

author: private-claude
name: T04
source:
theorem T04 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeDet N M < 0 → 0 < m.S := by
  intro m N M h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hS
  have hS' : 0 ≤ -m.S := by omega
  have e : m.modeDet N M = m.detJ * (M*M) - (N*M) * m.S + (N*N) * (m.Du * m.Dv) := by
    unfold Scope.Model.modeDet Scope.Model.detJ Scope.Model.S
    grind
  have p1 : 0 < m.detJ * (M*M) := Int.mul_pos h1 (Int.mul_pos h4 h4)
  have p2 : 0 ≤ (N*M) * (-m.S) := Int.mul_nonneg (Int.mul_nonneg h5 (by omega)) hS'
  have p3 : 0 ≤ (N*N) * (m.Du * m.Dv) := Int.mul_nonneg (Int.mul_nonneg h5 h5) (Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) (by omega))
  rw [Int.mul_neg] at p2
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeDet N M < 0 → 0 < m.S

author: private-claude
name: T05
source:
theorem T05 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → 0 < m.modeDet N M := by
  intro m N M hdet hM hN h hD
  have h1 : N * (m.S * M) ≤ N * (m.Du * m.Dv * N) := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hN
  have h2 : 0 < M * M * m.detJ := Int.mul_pos (Int.mul_pos hM hM) hdet
  have key : m.modeDet N M = M * M * m.detJ - N * (m.S * M) + N * (m.Du * m.Dv * N) := by
    unfold Scope.Model.modeDet Scope.Model.detJ Scope.Model.S
    grind
  rw [key]
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → 0 < m.modeDet N M

author: private-claude
name: T07
source:
theorem T07 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.S * p ^ 2 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 → ∀ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n → 0 ≤ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p) := by
  intro m p s h1 hp h2 h3 n hn
  have hsq : ∀ a : Int, a ^ 2 = a * a := by
    intro a
    simp [Int.pow_succ]
  have hM : 0 < Scope.modeM p := by
    unfold Scope.modeM
    rw [hsq]
    exact Int.mul_pos hp hp
  have hN : 0 ≤ Scope.modeN s n := by
    unfold Scope.modeN
    exact Int.mul_nonneg (Int.sq_nonneg _) (Int.sq_nonneg _)
  have hn' : (1:Int) ≤ (n:Int) := by omega
  have hn2 : (1:Int) ≤ (n:Int) ^ 2 := by
    rw [hsq]
    have := Int.mul_le_mul hn' hn' (by omega) (by omega)
    simpa using this
  have e : 1 * s ^ 2 ≤ (n:Int) ^ 2 * s ^ 2 :=
    Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hn2 (Int.sq_nonneg s)
  have e2 : m.Du * m.Dv * (1 * s ^ 2) ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * ((n:Int) ^ 2 * s ^ 2) :=
    Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e h2
  have hle : m.S * Scope.modeM p ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * Scope.modeN s n := by
    unfold Scope.modeM Scope.modeN
    have : m.Du * m.Dv * (1 * s ^ 2) = m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 := by simp
    omega
  exact Int.le_of_lt (T05 m _ _ h1 hM hN hle h2)
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.S * p ^ 2 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 → ∀ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n → 0 ≤ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p)

author: private-claude
name: T09
source:
theorem T09 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeDet N M < 0 → 0 < m.S ∧ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ < m.S ^ 2 := by
  intro m N M h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6
  refine ⟨T04 m N M h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6, ?_⟩
  have e : m.modeDet N M = m.detJ * M^2 - N * M * m.S + N^2 * (m.Du * m.Dv) := by
    unfold Scope.Model.modeDet Scope.Model.detJ Scope.Model.S
    grind
  have hP : 0 < m.Du * m.Dv := Int.mul_pos h2 h3
  have key : 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.modeDet N M
      = (2 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * N - m.S * M)^2 - m.S^2 * M^2 + 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ * M^2 := by
    rw [e]; grind
  have hneg : 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.modeDet N M < 0 :=
    Int.mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (by omega) h6
  have hsq := Int.sq_nonneg (2 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * N - m.S * M)
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro h
  have h' : 0 ≤ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ - m.S ^ 2 := by omega
  have h'' := Int.mul_nonneg h' (Int.sq_nonneg M)
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeDet N M < 0 → 0 < m.S ∧ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ < m.S ^ 2

author: private-claude
name: T10
source:
theorem T10 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.modeDet N M < 0 → m.detJ * M < m.S * N := by
  intro m N M hM hN hD hdet
  have h : m.modeDet N M = m.detJ*M*M - m.S*N*M + (m.Du*m.Dv)*(N*N) := by
    unfold Scope.Model.modeDet Scope.Model.detJ Scope.Model.S
    grind
  have h2 : 0 ≤ (m.Du*m.Dv)*(N*N) := Int.mul_nonneg hD (Int.mul_nonneg hN hN)
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hc
  have h3 : 0 ≤ (m.detJ*M - m.S*N) * M := Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) (by omega)
  have h4 : (m.detJ*M - m.S*N) * M = m.detJ*M*M - m.S*N*M := by grind
  omega
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.modeDet N M < 0 → m.detJ * M < m.S * N

author: private-claude
name: T11
source:
theorem T11 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → (∃ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n ∧ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p) < 0) → m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 < m.S * p ^ 2 := by
  intro m p s h1 h2 h3 hex
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hd⟩ := hex
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro h
  have h4 : m.S * p ^ 2 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 := Int.not_lt.mp h
  have h5 := T07 m p s h1 h2 h3 h4 n hn
  omega
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → (∃ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n ∧ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p) < 0) → m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 < m.S * p ^ 2

author: private-claude
name: T12
source:
theorem T12 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.trJ < 0 → 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N → Scope.Hurwitz (m.modeTr N M) (m.modeDet N M) := by
  intro m N M htr hdet hDu hDv hM hN hS
  have h1 := T01 m N M
  have h5 := T05 m N M hdet hM hN hS (Int.le_of_lt (Int.mul_pos hDu hDv))
  unfold Scope.Hurwitz
  constructor
  · rw [h1]
    have a : m.trJ * M < 0 := Int.mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos htr hM
    have b : 0 ≤ (m.Du + m.Dv) * N := Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) hN
    omega
  · exact h5
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.trJ < 0 → 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N → Scope.Hurwitz (m.modeTr N M) (m.modeDet N M)
